description: Create or edit one unit of measure. Omit id to create (abbreviation, name and type required; type is quantity, weight, volume or dimension); pass id to edit, where every omitted field keeps its value. Abbreviations are unique per tenant. A unit's type cannot change while items or conversions use it. isDefault=true makes it the default unit new items take; the preview names the unit that loses the flag. The tenant always keeps a default: the current one stays default until another unit takes the flag. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential. For bulk onboarding use upsert_uoms.

id.description: The unit id (GUID) to edit; omit to create.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

abbreviation.description: Abbreviation (e.g. "ea", "cs", "kg"), unique per tenant (case-insensitive). Required when creating.

description.description: Optional description. An empty string clears it.

isDefault.description: true makes this the tenant's default unit, applied to new items (the previous default loses the flag). The current default cannot be switched off here: make another unit the default instead.

type.description: quantity, weight, volume or dimension. Required when creating; cannot change while items or conversions use the unit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: save_uom
title: Save Unit of Measure
